verdict.rationale: A natural-language command interface is a fair capability for an ATS SaaS, so the axis applies, but no evidence shows users operating Greenhouse through natural-language commands. The AI features in the pack are adjacent: 'AI-powered report filters' never mentions natural-language input, Voice AI interviews candidates rather than taking operator commands, and Notetaker only summarizes interviews.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
